contentPattern.structure: single image beside a coloured content panel with heading + description + one CTA button

suitableFor: single side-by-side promotional / call-to-action banners (image next to a coloured content panel)
image + heading + description + single button layouts
notSuitableFor: two symmetric feature panels each with an image + link list (use columns-feature)
icon + short label quick-link grids (use cards-links)
